items.name: sidebar-list
items.title: Sidebar List
items.description: Providerless sidebar list primitives for embedded viewer and domain sidebars.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder with shimmer animation.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: A themed toast provider for Sonner.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A compact loading spinner using Lucide.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable panel primitives using react-resizable-panels.

items.name: csv
items.title: CSV parser
items.description: A small, dependency-free RFC 4180-ish CSV/TSV parser returning a header and rectangular rows.

items.name: pdf-document-resource
items.title: PDF Document Resource
items.description: Load and cache PDF.js documents and pages without viewer chrome.

items.name: docx-document-resource
items.title: DOCX Document Resource
items.description: Load and cache DOCX bytes without viewer chrome.

items.name: csv-viewer
items.title: CSV Viewer
items.description: A fixed-window virtualized CSV/TSV table: sortable columns, sticky header, row numbers, horizontal scroll. Renders straight from raw rows (no table row model) so it stays flat in memory on huge files.

items.name: pdf-viewer
items.title: PDF Viewer
items.description: A pdfjs-backed PDF viewer: continuous scroll, controlled or uncontrolled zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, a per-page overlay slot for bounding-box citations, a PdfHighlight overlay, and imperative scrollToPage / scrollToPageArea handles for driving source highlights.

items.name: docx-viewer
items.title: DOCX Viewer
items.description: A docx-preview-backed Word viewer: faithful paginated pages, continuous scroll, zoom, fit-to-width, and download. Off-screen pages are skipped via CSS content-visibility.

items.name: image-viewer
items.title: Image Viewer
items.description: A performant image viewer with native off-thread decode (createImageBitmap), continuous scroll, zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, and a per-frame overlay slot. Renders multi-page TIFF scans efficiently: frames decode lazily near the viewport and decoded bitmaps are capped. No useEffect.

items.name: layout-blocks
items.title: Layout Blocks
items.description: A provider-agnostic layout inspection component for OCR output: normalize Google Document AI, AWS Textract, or Azure Document Intelligence into shared blocks, lines, and words, then review them over the source page with virtualized rows, confidence filtering, and precise overlays.

items.name: pptx-viewer
items.title: PPTX Viewer
items.description: A canvas-backed PowerPoint viewer rendered entirely client-side (no server conversion): continuous scroll, zoom, rotate, fit-to-width, download, and a per-slide overlay slot. Slides render lazily near the viewport and renders are serialized.

items.name: xlsx-worker-protocol
items.title: XLSX worker protocol
items.description: Typed worker messages, parse limits, and error codes for the XLSX viewer.

items.name: xlsx-workbook
items.title: XLSX workbook model
items.description: Sparse compact workbook helpers for the XLSX viewer: cell lookup, metadata projection, column labels, and bounded source caching.

items.name: xlsx-sheetjs-flattener
items.title: XLSX SheetJS flattener
items.description: Pure SheetJS-to-compact-sheet flattening helpers for the XLSX viewer worker.

items.name: xlsx-viewer
items.title: XLSX Viewer
items.description: A fixed-window virtualized Excel/spreadsheet viewer rendered entirely client-side: sheet tabs, zoom, download, formatted values, numeric alignment, sparse workbook storage, and row + column virtualization so huge sheets stay smooth. No useEffect for data loading.

items.name: file-viewer
items.title: File Viewer
items.description: One viewer for any file: detects the type and lazy-loads the matching renderer (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, images) plus inline, virtualized text/code/JSON, Markdown (sandboxed), and HTML (sandboxed). Only the needed parser is ever downloaded.

items.name: file-system
items.title: File System
items.description: A document workspace over a flat object-store manifest with list, grid, columns, lazy folders, generated thumbnails, and FileViewer previews.

items.name: file-system-light
items.title: File System Light
items.description: A minimal file tree in a ViewerSidebar with FileViewer in the ViewerSurface.

items.name: document-source
items.title: Document source model
items.description: Viewer-agnostic model for extraction sources (the Retab /v1/extractions/{id}/sources shape): SourceAnchor union (pdf_bbox, image_bbox, spreadsheet/csv cell, docx/text span), Source, ExtractionSourcesResponse, and extractionSourcesToSourceMap to flatten the sources tree into a path-keyed SourceMap.

items.name: pdf-source
items.title: PDF source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the PDF viewer: pdfAnchorToTarget and renderPdfSourceOverlay for PDF bbox anchors.

items.name: segments
items.title: Segments model
items.description: Shared model + helpers for page-segmented results (partition/split): Segment type, Tableau palette, color map, page-range and confidence helpers.

items.name: segment-interaction
items.title: Segment Interaction
items.description: React-free hover, focus, selection, and current-page helpers for Segment[] surfaces.

items.name: use-segment-interaction
items.title: useSegmentInteraction
items.description: Client hook that coordinates hover, focus, and persistent selection across Segment[] surfaces.

items.name: segment-legend
items.title: Segment Legend
items.description: Compact color legend for a Segment[] with shared hover, focus, and selection state.

items.name: segment-sidebar
items.title: Segment Sidebar
items.description: Selectable list of segments with page ranges and confidence bars.

items.name: page-timeline
items.title: Page Timeline
items.description: A colored page strip that ties a Segment[] to the document; hover/select syncing and click-to-jump.

items.name: page-ribbon
items.title: Page Ribbon
items.description: A page-axis ribbon: segments drawn as blocks spanning their pages. One vertical lane = a split sidebar; many horizontal rows (consensus + votes) = a partition waterfall. Shared hover/focus/selection + click-to-jump.

items.name: segment-page-rail
items.title: Segment Page Rail
items.description: Vertical page rail for Segment[] documents with current-page following, scroll progress, and page selection.

items.name: segmented-document
items.title: Segmented Document
items.description: Shared segmented-document model, provider, viewport controller, and anchor navigation for split, partition, source, OCR, and bbox viewers.

items.name: schema-builder
items.title: Schema Builder
items.description: Controlled JSON Schema editor for building Retab extraction schemas — fields, types, nested objects, arrays, enums, and required flags.

items.name: attachment-sidebar
items.title: Attachment Sidebar
items.description: File attachment navigator built from SidebarList primitives and FileThumbnail.

items.name: email-viewer
items.title: Email Viewer
items.description: Render recursive MIME messages with headers, CID inline resources, nested messages, and File Viewer leaves.

items.name: file-thumbnail-frame
items.title: File Thumbnail Frame
items.description: Dependency-free thumbnail frame with a loading shimmer, fade-in, and muted fallback surface.

items.name: file-thumbnail
items.title: File Thumbnail
items.description: Render complete file thumbnails from browser files, URLs, blobs, text sources, external images, or custom preview content.

items.name: run-card
items.title: Run Card
items.description: A document run card: a file thumbnail with a status pill, a heading, and a result slot. Composes file-thumbnail; the result rendering is left to its children.

items.name: ocr-block
items.title: OCR
items.description: OCR review for a scanned document: source page, detected text blocks, confidence filtering, and matching polygon overlays. Switch between Google Document AI, AWS Textract, and Azure Document Intelligence output.

items.name: split-viewer-block
items.title: Split Viewer
items.description: Named subdocuments over a PDF: a legend header and a vertical page-ribbon sidebar, from the shared segment primitives.

items.name: partition-viewer-block
items.title: Partition Viewer
items.description: Keyed chunks over a PDF: a legend plus a horizontal page-ribbon waterfall, from the shared segment primitives.

items.name: parse-viewer-block
items.title: Parse Viewer
items.description: The source document beside its extracted markdown, synced by page, with a Rendered/Text toggle.

items.name: edit-viewer-block
items.title: Edit Viewer
items.description: Detected form fields beside a PDF source document, linked by their bbox — hover or select a field to highlight its region on the page; Preview stamps values over the source, and Filled renders a supplied output file.

items.name: excel-splitting-viewer-block
items.title: Excel Splitting
items.description: One Excel workbook fanned out into several clean CSVs — each reconstructed table rendered in the viewer, with a sidebar listing every CSV the splitter emitted, the sheet it was carved from, and how it was reconstructed. Selecting one opens that CSV.

items.name: txt-splitting-viewer-block
items.title: Text Splitting
items.description: One plain-text batch file separated into several documents — each carved-out document rendered in the viewer, with a left sidebar listing the source file first, then every document the splitter emitted, its type, line count, and the boundary cue that detected it. Selecting one opens that document.

items.name: extract-viewer-block
items.title: Extract Viewer
items.description: Extracted data beside the source PDF, rendered as a JSON form and linked by sources — hover or select a field to highlight where its value came from and scroll the page to it.

items.name: sources-viewer-block
items.title: Sources Viewer
items.description: Every source-backed format in one viewer — PDF/image bbox sources use segmented-document anchors; text, CSV, Excel, and Word use segmented source links with format-specific target adapters.

items.name: json-form-sources-block
items.title: JSON Form Sources
items.description: Extraction rendered as a JSON form beside the source PDF — hover a form field to highlight where its value came from through segmented-document state.

items.name: pdf-viewer-thumbnails
items.title: PDF Viewer Thumbnails
items.description: PDF-owned page thumbnail navigation for explicit PdfViewer composition: lazy pdfjs thumbnails, active-page highlight, and click-to-jump.

items.name: dropzone-block
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A file-uploader lab proving the headless dropzone primitive across default, non-button, native-button, controlled, validation-only, custom grid, upload progress, uploader-viewer, and disabled surfaces.

items.name: file-system-block
items.title: File System
items.description: A document workspace over a flat object-store manifest with list, grid, columns, generated thumbnails, and persistent file previews.

items.name: fslight-block
items.title: File System Light
items.description: A purified composition experiment: file tree in a ViewerSidebar, selected source rendered by FileViewer in a ViewerSurface.

items.name: primitive-run-cards
items.title: Primitive Run Card Components
items.description: Prop-driven run cards for each Retab primitive — classify, split, partition, parse, and extract — each framing the source document with that primitive's result over the shared RunCard shell. Presentational: pass the resolved result (category, segments, markdown, or extract fields), so the same cards render a static demo or a live workflow run's per-block result.

items.name: primitive-cards-block
items.title: Primitive Run Cards
items.description: Each Retab primitive's result framed as a run card — a document thumbnail with a status pill and the primitive's output in the card body. Classification shows the page with its category and reasoning; split a mini page rail of color-keyed subdocuments; partition a keyed-chunk legend with an overlap ribbon; parse the page rendered as markdown; extract the page with each field's source box drawn over it. Composes the primitive-run-cards components over sample results.

items.name: pdf-thumbnails-block
items.title: PDF Thumbnails
items.description: A PDF viewer with toggleable page thumbnails in a viewer navigation rail.

items.name: source-field-list
items.title: Source field list
items.description: A field list that drives source-field interaction: hover previews the field location in the viewer, click selects it.

items.name: source-field-link
items.title: Source field link
items.description: A field-path adapter over segmented-document anchors.

items.name: document-anchor
items.title: Document anchor
items.description: Pure document location types used by evidence projection and viewer target adapters.

items.name: document-evidence
items.title: Document evidence
items.description: Pure projection types for semantic evidence rows that can resolve to document anchors.

items.name: interactive-item-list
items.title: Interactive item list
items.description: A virtualized listbox interaction primitive for preview, selection, keyboard navigation, and visible-item reporting.

items.name: source-evidence
items.title: Source evidence

items.name: source-segmented-document

items.name: layout-blocks-segmented-document
items.title: Layout blocks segmented document

items.name: source-anchor
items.title: Source anchor
items.description: Pure conversion from document-source anchors to document viewer anchors.

items.name: image-source
items.title: Image source adapter
items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the image viewer: imageAnchorToTarget, rotateImageArea, and renderImageSourceOverlay for image_bbox anchors.

items.name: code-viewer
items.title: Code Viewer

items.name: text-viewer
items.title: Text Viewer

items.name: text-viewer-chenglou

items.name: markdown-viewer

items.name: text-source
items.title: Text source adapter

items.name: csv-source

items.name: xlsx-source

items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the XLSX viewer: xlsxAnchorToTarget and sourceToXlsxCell for spreadsheet_cell anchors.

items.name: docx-source

items.description: Bridges the document-source model to the DOCX viewer: docxAnchorToTarget and sourceToDocxHighlight for docx_text_span and docx_table_cell anchors.

items.name: image-sources-block
items.title: Image Sources
items.description: Extracted fields linked to a scanned page image — hover to highlight the image_bbox region.

items.name: text-sources-block
items.title: Text Sources
items.description: Values extracted from a log file linked to the lines they came from — hover to highlight a line range.

items.name: docx-sources-block
items.title: DOCX Sources
items.description: Values extracted from a Word document linked back to where they came from — hover to highlight the text and scroll to it.

items.name: csv-sources-block
items.title: CSV Sources
items.description: Extracted values linked to spreadsheet cells — hover to highlight a cell and scroll to it.

items.name: xlsx-sources-block
items.title: Excel Sources
items.description: Extracted values linked to spreadsheet cells across sheets — hover to switch sheet, highlight the cell, and scroll to it.

items.name: source-indicator
items.title: Source indicator
items.description: A floating pill that reports active field source state over a viewer: nothing selected, a located field path, or a field with no source.

items.name: dropzone-file-uploader-example
items.title: Default File Uploader
items.description: The standard visual file uploader built on the headless dropzone primitive.

items.name: dropzone-file-viewer-example
items.title: Uploader + Viewer
items.description: One upload surface that becomes a file viewer, with the uploaded blob rendered by FileViewer.

items.name: dropzone-non-button-trigger
items.title: Non-Button Trigger
items.description: A custom element opens the file dialog while preserving dropzone state.

items.name: dropzone-native-button-queue

items.description: A real button trigger with browser button semantics and a small selected-file queue.

items.name: dropzone-controlled-queue
items.title: Controlled Queue

items.name: dropzone-validation-only

items.name: dropzone-custom-thumbnail-grid
items.title: Custom Thumbnail Grid

items.name: dropzone-media-transcript-queue

items.name: dropzone-upload-progress-queue
items.title: Upload Progress Queue

items.name: dropzone-avatar-image-slot
items.title: Avatar Image Slot
items.description: A single replaceable image slot with a custom circular preview.

items.name: dropzone-spreadsheet-import-card
items.title: Spreadsheet Import
items.description: A single spreadsheet upload feeding a mapping workflow.

items.name: dropzone-evidence-timeline
items.title: Evidence Timeline
items.description: Files become ordered evidence events inside a custom surface.

items.name: dropzone-comparison-pair-upload
items.title: Comparison Pair
items.description: Two independent dropzones model original versus revision documents.

items.name: dropzone-intake-router
items.title: Intake Router
items.description: One intake target routes selected files into document, image, and table lanes.

items.name: dropzone-required-packet-slots
items.title: Required Packet
items.description: Slot-level dropzones for checklist-driven packet collection.

items.name: dropzone-pinboard-drop-surface
items.title: Pinboard Drop Surface
items.description: A full canvas trigger that pins dropped files as cards.

items.name: dropzone-disabled-dropzone
items.title: Disabled Dropzone
items.description: Disabled input, trigger focus, intake, and drag behavior.

items.name: split-consensus-viewer-block
items.title: Split Consensus
items.description: A split result with multi-run consensus visible in the sidebar: the page rail stays beside output-level likelihoods and each vote used to build the final split.

items.name: split-consensus-diagram-horizontal-viewer-block
items.title: Split Consensus Diagram Horizontal
items.description: A split consensus segment diagram with consolidation, five raw votes, and contested-page density in a wide horizontal sidebar beside the PDF.

items.name: split-consensus-diagram-vertical-viewer-block
items.title: Split Consensus Diagram Vertical
items.description: A split consensus segment diagram with the page axis running vertically for a narrow sidebar beside the PDF.

items.name: split-consensus-lukas-viewer-block
items.title: Split Consensus Lukas
items.description: The split benchmark diagram from Lukas Bjorkland's article, with GT, Split v1, Split v2, the PDF pane, and the same dark metrics table treatment.

items.name: classify-consensus-viewer-block
items.title: Classify Consensus
items.description: A classification result with consensus visible in the sidebar: selected category, likelihood, and every vote beside the source document.
